native_pr.title: feat(llm): wait for live budget capacity without serializing affordable calls

root_finding: Temporary reserve_wait admission used fail-fast reserve and persisted ledger.refusal; after admission later RPC failure could be translated into BudgetExceeded by Embed, suppressing healthy fallback. Cancellation of queued admission could leave the same marker.
evidence: Native temporary-refusal regression failed before fix.
Actual SDK wire regression failed: a primary HTTP 400 after queued admission was incorrectly terminal BudgetExceeded and healthy fallback was unused.
Native fix uses silent atomic admission for temporary waits; 617 LLM unit tests pass, preserving real fail-fast refusal history.

Actual SDK wire regressions pass: queued admission permits the healthy fallback after a primary HTTP 400; canceling a wait dispatches no request and charges nothing. SDK library 190, two capacity wire tests, ten budget fanout tests and twelve route tests pass.
limitation: This is a cross-repository API compatibility defect; the original native-only review did not contain the SDK caller code. Preserve as a specific missed defect, not a general recall estimate.
